criteria.description: Representative transitional REST writes for services, deployment intents, LLM route creation, and policy create/update/delete publish signer-first ContextVM/Nostr commands and return HTTP 202 CommandReceipt metadata, including request_event_id, request_pubkey, request_kind, status/result/read-model kinds, idempotency key, and published relay count.
Command publishers verify relay OK acceptance through publisher receipts and fail the REST request when no relay accepts the command.
Tests are deterministic and event-driven: they inspect captured publishes and handler responses directly without sleeps or timeout-based completion detection.
API and user-guide documentation describe the transitional receipt behavior and preserve the rule that durable completion comes from scoped Nostr observables, not the REST response.

Policy mutation receipt routes require explicit policies:write authorization scoped to the target environment or existing policy, partial policy updates do not emit omitted fields as false/empty values, LLM route-create requires org-scoped llm_routes:write authorization, and LLM route-create rejects empty names before publishing.
CommandReceipt REST adapters preserve publisher-supplied correlation metadata, including d_tag and non-default timeout_seconds; timeout defaults are applied only when omitted by the publisher.
